name: Inaho Suzu
source: A prolific novelist and the older sister of [url=/c66131]Inaho Shin[/url]. She is the actual owner of "YuKuRu" but pushed the job of managing it onto Shin. She sometimes holes inside a room on the second floor of the café to write her manuscripts. She sees [url=/c64617]Noelle[/url] as a little sister and will test anyone asking for her hand.
